tools.name: scan_accessibility
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a public website or web page checked for accessibility (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA, ADA, EAA, Section 508): it loads the live page in a real browser, runs axe-core on it and up to two more same-site pages, and returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade and the failing rules with example

tools.name: explain_accessibility_issue
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what an axe-core accessibility rule means or how to fix it — such as color-contrast, image-alt, label or link-name. Returns plain-English steps and a code example. Do not use it when the user wants a site checked; it explains a rule and does not scan pages.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "explain_accessibility_issue" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
